Class Mailbox

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.Mailbox
public final class Mailbox extends Object
One mailbox for every Tempest plugin (Core API version 6). A plugin sends a parcel of items and money to a player instead of dropping it at their feet or losing it: the player is offline, their inventory is full, or the reward is one they should take when they want. Players open theirs with /mail, are told when one arrives and when they join, and see "Mail: 2" on the Tempest board. 
Mailbox.send(uuid, "Dragons", "server.dragons.mail.reward", Map.of("dragon", "Ember"),
        List.of(new Mailbox.Item("Rock_Gem_Ruby", 3)), 500);
The title is a translation key from the sending plugin's server.lang, so each player reads it in their language; a parameter whose value starts with % is a translation key too ("%server.dragons.name.ember"). Money is paid through the server's economy when the parcel is claimed. Parcels are kept in universe/mods/atomictempest/mail/, one file per player. Any thread.

    • send

      public static String send(UUID player, String from, String titleKey, Map<String,String> params, List<Mailbox.Item> items, long money)
      Sends a parcel. Items with no id or an amount under 1 are left out.
      Parameters:
      from - the sending plugin's name, shown with the parcel
      titleKey - a translation key ("server.dragons.mail.reward"), or null for "A parcel"
      params - the title's parameters, or null
      Returns:
      the parcel's id, or null when nothing was sent (nothing in it, or the mailbox is full)
